mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through reduced consumer spending and earnings growth concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units and industrial production below 100.0 index signals broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) triggers Fed tightening expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to rising discount rates and equity valuation pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of high-inflation periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production growth above 0.5% monthly signals strong economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through improved corporate earnings visibility and risk-on sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of INDPRO growth periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1500 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as consumer spending and economic growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous Fed rate cuts (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) signal dovish policy response to inflation, generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through liquidity support and risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS monthly growth > 0.5%) supports consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through improved earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of strong-labor periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
